matchup.plan_title: Plan (10:35 UTC 18 Nov): claim Jeremiah Fears, drop Mo Bamba
matchup.plan_md:
**Plan line:** 2 adds.

**Why Bamba, not Jenkins** (the user's call, and the numbers allow it):
- **The script's comparison.** Lineup over 19–22 Nov, each run at 10:30 UTC:

| Option | Adds for the plan | Lineup 19–22 Nov |
|---|---:|---:|
| No claim | 5 | 1,032 (909 + 122.9) |
| Claim Fears, drop Jenkins | 4 | 1,002 (905 + 97.1) |
| **Claim Fears, drop Bamba** | 4 | 987 (913 + 74.1); **983 with the 2-add line** (913 + 70.3) |

- **The 15-point gap is smaller than it looks.** It values Bamba at his starter's rate: 32.7, with L7 38.2 (4), 35–36 min in his start.
  - Jaxson Hayes's return ends that start. Hayes's next chance is 18 Nov at LAL ([RotoWire, 17 Nov](https://www.rotowire.com/basketball/headlines/jaxson-hayes-injury-remaining-out-tuesday-539488)); no timetable reported; *ESPN est.* 18 Nov.
  - The drop-Jenkins plan keeps Bamba through 20 Nov, so it loses most of its edge if Hayes plays.
- **Jenkins keeps his start while Robinson and Duren are out.** The rate already counts this through the role row (35 min, role rate 36.7 ‡).
  - Duncan Robinson is re-evaluated in a week ([Hoops Rumors, 17 Nov](https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2026/11/pistons-duncan-robinson-quad-out-at-least-one-week.html)); *ESPN est.* 27 Nov.
  - Jalen Duren is re-evaluated about 22 Nov; *ESPN est.* 24 Nov.
- **Not Gobert.** The claim processes at 3:00 AM ET 19 Nov, before Gobert's 19 Nov game, the thinnest day of the week (2 of ours play).

**The claim:**
- File it now: **add Jeremiah Fears, drop Mo Bamba**.
- It processes **Thu 19 Nov at 3:00 AM ET, 7:00 PM Thu 19 Melbourne**, after Bamba's 18 Nov game.
- Bench Bamba on 18 Nov anyway: 11 of ours play for 10 slots.
- **Waiver priority:** 6th of 8. Cream Abdul-Yammar, Matt Wright's Foxies, Snow Time Lakers, Lauri Birds and Dr White Slong are ahead of us.

**Then 2 adds, +70.3** (ESPN dates, Melbourne times):
1. **20 Nov:** drop Gobert after his game vs NY ends (tip-off Fri 20, 12:00 PM). Add **Quentin Grimes** (LAL) before his game vs SAC (Sat 21, 2:00 PM).
   - Only if Austin Reaves is still out ([NBC Sports, 17 Nov](https://www.nbcsports.com/fantasy/basketball/player-news/2026-11-17/redick-reaves-to-test-injured-heel-wednesday)); *ESPN est.* 18 Nov.
2. **21 Nov:** drop Grimes after his game. Add **Neemias Queta** (BOS) before BOS @SAC (Sun 22, 2:00 PM).

**Why 2 adds and not 4:**
- The 4-add line (+74.1) gains only 3.8 more.
- It swaps Gobert for Myles Turner on 19 Nov, the second night of Milwaukee's back-to-back. Turner rested the second night on 11 Nov, so Gobert's 19 Nov game would be at risk for nothing.
- It also adds De'Andre Hunter (SAC). He is day-to-day with hip soreness (no timetable reported; *ESPN est.* 18 Nov), and his L7 rests on one game.

**If Reaves is back:** 1 add, +34.0. On 20 Nov, drop Gobert after his game, and add **Aday Mara** (OKC) before OKC vs NO (Sat 21, 12:00 PM). He also plays 22 Nov.

**If the claim fails** (a team ahead of us takes Fears), keep Bamba and follow the no-claim plan:
- **20 Nov:** Gobert → Grimes (if Reaves is out).
- **21 Nov:** Grimes → Queta, and Bamba → Pritchard.

That is 3 adds for +91.7.

**Form:**

| Player | Rate | Season | L7 | L15 | L30 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Jeremiah Fears | 34.4 | 32.5 (15) | 37.2 (4) | 35.1 (9) | 32.5 (15) |
| Mo Bamba | 32.7 | 30.8 (11) | 38.2 (4) | 33.0 (7) | 30.8 (11) |
| Daniss Jenkins | 34.0 (role rate 36.7 ‡) | 30.2 (13) | 37.0 (3) | 38.5 (6) | 30.2 (13) |
| Rudy Gobert | 25.9 | 25.6 (14) | 22.5 (4) | 27.3 (7) | 25.6 (14) |
| Quentin Grimes | 36.9 | 23.2 (13) | 59.0 (2), small sample | 29.3 (6) | 23.2 (13) |
| Neemias Queta | — | 25.6 (13) | 34.0 (2), small sample | 27.3 (6) | 25.6 (13) |

**Why the L7s are high:**
- **Bamba, +7.4:** his start for Hayes.
- **Jenkins, +6.8:** his start while Duren and Robinson are out.
- **Grimes, +35.8:** two starts for Reaves.
- **Queta, +8.4:** two games, a small sample.
